summary: Marion County, OR, tower: 82-ft L-6 built 1937 with a ground cabin; staffed in 1940 and 1952; gone by 1967 (c.1965 per Forest Lookouts); no current site description found.

facts.design: 82-foot timber L-6 tower with ground cabin
facts.status_note: Tower gone by 1967 per the register and firelookout.com; Forest Lookouts says removed about 1965

Clayton Wiggins in his second season as lookout (The Oregon Statesman, July 14, 1940, as quoted by Forest Lookouts)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1936 Oregon Statesman items give the tower as 90 feet and describe it already standing; the register and firelookout.com give 82 feet and a 1937 build. The record keeps the 82-foot figure (25.0 m), and the story reports both.
Forest Lookouts says the tower was removed about 1965; the register and firelookout.com say gone by 1967. The record keeps gone, and the story gives both dates.

notes_for_editor: Access is unknown and no source describes the site today, so no access or visit facts are recorded. The 1936 newspaper items describe a tower already standing, before the register's 1937 build date. Removal is 1965 in Forest Lookouts and by 1967 in the register and firelookout.com. The register calls the agency the Oregon Department of Forestry; firelookout.com says Oregon Division of Forestry. The 1936 and 1940 newspaper quotes are read through the Forest Lookouts page; the originals were not checked.
